stories.title: Curry Extension Clock — 8 Days to Warriors Media Day

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
**Post 1 (9:00 AM ET — Morning recap)**
8 days to Warriors media day. Steph Curry still hasn't signed the $136.7M extension. Mutual interest confirmed. Both sides have full structural flexibility. Still no announcement. Sept. 28 is coming fast. #Warriors #NBA
